failures.rule: product/ui-constitution.md, Article 6: Name the escape; Article 2.1: know whether anything will be lost if the app is ignored

failures.issue: The offer asks for a decision but gives no expiry or other explanation of what happens if it is ignored. The seller cannot tell whether waiting risks losing it.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md, Part IV B28; Article 7.6 and Part III App canvas
failures.place: Entire phone screen, excluding the gray side gutters
failures.issue: The white phone canvas is approximately 810 × 1536 pixels. At 390 points wide this is approximately 390 × 740, not the required 390 × 844. The supplied board therefore does not show the required true-scale app viewport.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md, Part IV B17; Part III App margins; brand/ledger.md, Decided A3
failures.place: Left and right edges of the list and action rows
failures.issue: Relative to the white phone canvas, the list rules and offer field begin about 25 pixels from the edge, approximately 12 points at 390-point width; photos begin about 34 pixels in, approximately 16 points. These are not the required 20-point app margins.

failures.rule: brand/ledger.md, Decided A1; brand/constitution.md, Article 5 color table and States

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md, Part IV B19; Article 7.3; Article 13 nested-box tell
failures.place: First hairline card, around the gradient action strip
failures.issue: The outlined outer card contains a separate filled, rounded field panel. The field panel is not one of B19's permitted nested elements (photos, buttons, state pills or money highlights). The individual buttons are permitted; their extra enclosing panel creates the forbidden box inside a box.
